english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a hamburger or burger sandwich.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the hamburger sandwich.
Use 漢堡包 for the savoury roll used for a hamburger or similar sandwich.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1 m4 goi1

examples.english: I want a hamburger without onions.
examples.traditional: 我想要一個漢堡包，唔要洋蔥。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1 m4 jiu3 joeng4 cung1

examples.english: I want to eat a bun.
